display: Linear interpolation at approximately native-frame spacing for visualization only; per-trial native baseline subtraction; no SDF kernel or spike-rate conversion.
eligibility: NWB is_soma and Figure 4 class High SNR or Intermediate; no Hz threshold
example_rule: Shared positive Q1/Q2 responder maximizes minimum signed MI across both tests and signals. Shared Q2 p>=0.05, abs(MI)<0.25 comparison maximizes mean context OASIS response among active eligible ROIs. Not a claim of absent visual responsiveness.
statistics: Native finite-frame means; half-open 500-ms test and paired preceding-standard windows; Q2 subtracts each trial's full preceding-grey baseline. Paired two-sided Wilcoxon zsplit for Q1; unpaired two-sided Mann-Whitney for Q2. Exploratory strict p<0.05 and abs(MI)>0.1. BH q across all 2371 original ROIs, separately per signal/test.
